newsitem.title: MEXICO: Nine escape from maximum-security Mexican prison.
newsitem.headline: Nine escape from maximum-security Mexican prison.

text.p: Nine inmates escaped from a maximum-security prison in the western Mexican state of Michoacan after sawing through prison bars, the warden said on Saturday.

The escapees -- who had been convicted on charges including murder, rape, kidnapping and drug trafficking -- are considered highly dangerous, the Notimex state news agency reported, citing warden Luis Manuel Cabrera Cazares.
Two pickup trucks were waiting for the inmates outside the prison at the moment they escaped late on Friday night in the city of Uruapan, Cabrera told Notimex.
A special team of the Michoacan State Judicial Police is leading the search for the fugitives, Cabrera said.
